dex.entry: A large, heavily-built ore-beast that acts as a living conductor; veins of metallic mineral run visibly beneath its hide, and static builds in the mine walls around it. The terrifying final form of the mine-rat — it's become a living storm-generator buried in stone.

art.silhouette: Bear-sized quadruped; charcoal-black stone-dense hide with bright amber charge-lines tracing the mineral veins; mane of stiff iron-ore bristles along the neck; tail a coiled ore-spring that arcs sparks when lashing.
